title: Kalyug vs Krishna Rap Battle Mahabharat Bars ft @OfficialMrSevenMr7
blurb: Kalyug vs Krishna — a Mahabharat rap battle, with @OfficialMrSevenMr7 on the mic and the verse doing all the talking.
video_description:
Kalyug vs Krishna — a Mahabharat rap battle, with @OfficialMrSevenMr7 on the mic and the verse doing all the talking.

This is one of those videos I made because the idea wouldn't leave me alone. Take the oldest argument in the book and let both sides go at it in rhythm. On one side, the voice of the age we actually live in, the one people blame for everything. On the other, the voice that was always told it stood on the right side of the war. The Mahabharat is the frame, and honestly it's the best possible frame for this, because nobody in that story is a cartoon villain. Every character has a reason, and a rap battle is about as close as you get to letting two of those reasons argue in public.

The bars and the performance belong to @OfficialMrSevenMr7. The credit for the verses is entirely theirs, and that's the part worth supporting.

• Kalyug vs Krishna, built on a Mahabharat theme
